title: Unit Event — Step by Step! — Episode3 Separation

meta.Event Outline: Minori has told her groupmates in MORE MORE JUMP! that she wants to switch to the credit-based course. This hasn't been an easy decision to make, but she's been supported by some special people.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, Minori, you're thinking about switching to the credit-based course?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
But I haven't made my final decision yet...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... You and your group have become famous enough to start appearing on TV and radio programs together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: True. I remember hearing from Shizuku when she first enrolled that this school's credit-based course gives her more flexibility to work...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So, I think it's a good idea.
I mean, you want to keep pursuing your dream, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it is a little sad to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, it's just... I know you worked really hard to become an idol, and are still working hard...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
So if this makes things easier for you...
If you think this is the right way to go, Minori, I want to give you my support...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it also means seeing less of each other at school, and there'd be no chance of us being in the same class again.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was actually kinda bothering me too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi's currently credit-based, and Haruka was before... And they both said it was sad they didn't get to see their friends as much after switching...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, it seems only natural not being able to see your friends as much since you're going to physically be at school less.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure there's much you can do about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
At the same time, what do I know?
In the end, Minori, you have to make your own decision...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, if I were in your position, I'd probably choose the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, I wouldn't be able to see my friends as much, but we don't necessarily have to talk at school and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I may be busy working, but we could always set aside time to meet or hang out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And if going credit-based made it easier for me to make my dream come true, then I'd absolutely choose that option.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, um... I know I said that I'd be sad...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But placing myself in your shoes, Minori... I'd also probably want to switch if it was the best way to make my dream come true...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We might not be able to have lunch together or talk like this as much...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But your dream is to spread hope to as many people as you can as an idol... I really want that to happen.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you both.
I'm really glad I talked to you about this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like I got some courage!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And if I do end up switching to the credit-based course, I promise to still message you guys. Every single day...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, every single hour!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, that seems like a bit much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whaaat?!
Minori's Room

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I ended up making some Print Stickers with Shiho and Kohane♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll keep them in my phone case!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And I couldn't be happier...
They said they'll support my decision, and that we'll be friends forever...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I feel the same way...
I won't get to see them at school as much, but I still wanna keep being friends.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I'm sure it'll be okay... As long as we feel that way about each other, we're not going to end up completely separated.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That just leaves schoolwork.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Going credit-based means having to plan ahead and learn what I can from my textbooks. Plus, I won't really have time to ask my teachers any questions...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How am I gonna handle all that...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No, I can't let that get to me now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have to figure out a way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Mom! Dad!
There's something I need to discuss with you guys.
